IADC Tricone Rotary Rock Drill Bits

Precision Rock Formations: Soft Silt to Abrasive Granite & Basalt

Engineering Overview & Purpose

KD Sondaj supplies heavy-duty IADC tricone roller cone drill bits ranging from soft-formation milled tooth bits (IADC 111–217) to high-wear tungsten carbide insert (TCI) bits (IADC 517–637) with sealed journal bearings for extended bit life.

Field Applications

  • ✓ Deep rotary water well boreholes
  • ✓ Geothermal exploration and high-temperature drilling
  • ✓ Surface casing holes and deep coring operations
Geological Stratum Compatibility:

From soft clays and gravels to medium abrasive sandstones and hard granites.

Engineering Q&A Direct Answers

Q: Which drill bit types are used for different geological formations?

A: Soft formations (clay, marl) utilize long-tooth milled bits (IADC 111-117) for fast penetration. Medium-hard formations use chisel-shaped TCI inserts (IADC 517-537). Hard, abrasive rock (granite, basalt) requires compact conical TCI bits (IADC 617-637) with continuous crushing action.
